title: Storm-Day Leak Escalation Queue
dataSources: Radon readings (`radon:reading`), sump humidity events (`sump:humidity`), HVAC filter telemetry (`hvacfilter:reading`), and roof leak events (`roofleak:event`).
app: Home health telemetry from radon monitors, sump humidity probes, HVAC filter tracking, and roof leak sensors sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=roofleak:event
| search storm_day=true
| stats sum(wet_events) as wet_events max(severity_score) as max_severity_score by location_name
| sort 0 - wet_events
description: Ranks locationss by storm-day leak escalation.
value: Storm-day escalation helps you identify the roof area most likely to demand immediate work during the next bad weather event.
implementation: Send storm-day leak escalation events to `index=personal` and keep `location_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of storm-day leak escalation by locations.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which locationss stand out most for storm-day leak escalation.
